title: Review Weighted EPI Score behaviour at grand total (returns 7945.40 unfiltered)
description:
RECOMMENDATION — beyond the phase acceptance criteria, requires approval before execution.

Evaluated live with NO filter context, [Weighted EPI Score] returns 7945.40 — the SUMX accumulates weighted sub-indicator scores across all 193 countries rather than resolving to the 0-100 band the measure is documented to produce (docs/dax_measure_library.md line 118). In a single-country filter context it behaves as documented, and Erik confirmed the 0-100 rendering on 2026-08-04, so this is a NON-ADDITIVE-AT-TOTAL artifact, not a computation defect.

Worth a decision because an unfiltered card or an uncontexted total in report2 would show a meaningless 7945.40 to a portfolio reviewer. Options: wrap the measure to blank or average outside a country context, OR document the required filter context and confirm no visual can render it uncontexted.

Related observation while probing: [Latest Match Rate] returns BLANK against current gold_quality_history contents — confirm whether that is expected before the same reviewer meets an empty card.
acceptanceCriteria: A decision is recorded: wrap the measure, or document the required filter context.
If wrapped, the measure returns a meaningful value or BLANK at grand total and is unchanged in a single-country context.
No visual in report2 can render Weighted EPI Score without country context (or the uncontexted value is meaningful).
[Latest Match Rate]'s BLANK result is confirmed expected or fixed.
notes: [ATTEMPT 2 2026-08-11] Prose-only fix; TMDL untouched (confirmed unchanged from attempt 1) and semantic_model.md untouched (L132 does not repeat the false mechanism). docs/dax_measure_library.md: § 2.2's 'No 0 fallback' paragraph rewritten around the measured truth (removal is a no-op because the alternate result was unreachable), stating the discriminator inline with the control set; § 4's pattern bullet rewritten to be correct in its own right -- the EARLIER version ('the Weighted EPI Score collapse-to-0 case is a direct consequence') was wrong for the same reason, since that collapse never occurred; the non-country-grouping caveat added; and § 2.2's 'Reads 0-100 at every grain' heading clarified so it does not contradict the caveat. All three load-bearing claims re-measured live rather than taken on trust (DIVIDE truth table with 4 positive controls; WGI-context old measure = null not 0; 58 sub-indicators summing to 100.0, min 0.1, zero blank/zero-weight rows). Swept docs/ for the false mechanism elsewhere with a positive control -- no other doc repeats it. NOTE: measured 13 commodity_group rows, not the verifier's 4; the constant (44.141125003963616) and the old value (7945.402500713454) agree exactly.

[VERIFICATION FAIL #1 2026-08-11] FAIL attempt 1 -- prose/rationale only; the measure itself is correct and NO TMDL change is needed. Verifier independently re-derived AC2 against the live published model: 194 country keys, max |old-new| = 0.0 with blank-status identical on every row; grand total 44.14112500396361 = 7945.402500713454/180; Europe 58.594. TMDL integrity PASS -- lineageTag and PBI_FormatHint are unchanged CONTEXT lines, indentation verified byte-level against HEAD and a sibling multi-line measure. AC1/AC3 pass; AC4 passes on intent (defect confirmed with evidence rather than fixed). The failure: the DIVIDE-removal mechanism is false as written in three durable places. Both the dispatch brief's rationale AND the implementer's replacement were wrong; the alternate result never fires on a BLANK numerator, so the 0 was unreachable and the removal is a no-op.
CREATED 2026-08-05 by phase-level verification as out_of_spec — no acceptance criterion covers measure totals behaviour.
OUT OF SPEC: requires [A]ccept / [R]eject / [D]efer before it can be executed. Never auto-execute.
Not a correctness defect — behaves as documented under filter context.

OUT-OF-SPEC ACCEPTED 2026-08-05 (Erik, [A]). out_of_spec_approved=true — the task is now dispatchable like any other and runs the full implement -> verify cycle; the out_of_spec flag only excludes it from PHASE detection (so it cannot re-open a closed phase or trigger a re-verify loop), never from per-task verification. Owner is 'both': the measure change is Claude's, but confirming no report2 visual renders Weighted EPI Score without country context needs Erik in the report.
DECISION 2026-08-11 (Erik, verbatim: 'wrap it'): wrap the measure. Option B (document the required filter context) is rejected. Dispatched to implement-agent same day.

[IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-11] Wrapped the measure in AVERAGEX(VALUES(gold_dim_country[country_key]), <existing body>) and removed the DIVIDE alternate-result 0. Diagnosis confirmed live (executeQueries): 58 sub-indicators summing to weight 100, 180 countries with rows, and SUMX(VALUES(country_key), <per-country measure>) = 7945.40250071345 -- exactly the old grand total, so the total was the SUM of per-country averages. AC2 verified both directions by running the literal file text as DEFINE MEASURE: max delta 0.0 across 194 country keys in single-country context; 44.141 at grand total (58.594 for Europe). AC3 satisfied by its own parenthetical -- the uncontexted value is now meaningful, so no report visual audit is needed. AC4: [Latest Match Rate] is a DEFECT, diagnosed not fixed (out of scope) -- LatestRun takes MAX(refresh_timestamp) over the whole of gold_quality_history, but data_quality_checks stamps a later pipeline_run_ts than silver_to_gold in the same run and writes only dq_* rows, so the winning timestamp never carries the metric; [Latest Coverage Rate] is BLANK identically (the task only noticed Match Rate). NOTE the DIVIDE rationale in the dispatch brief was WRONG and the agent corrected it: DAX's alternate result fires only on a BLANK/0 DENOMINATOR, so a data-less country never hit it. The removal is still load-bearing via a filter context holding no EPI sub-indicator at all (WGI slicer, or the pre-task-056 all-NULL weights), where TotalWeights goes BLANK and the old fallback returned 0 = worst-possible score. Decision persisted as DEC-014. Friction: FR-069 (spec L1457 still says non-additive), FR-070 (task text still says 'report2'). NOT committed, NOT pushed -- deploy + in-report confirmation is Erik's half.

issues.description: The stated reason for removing the DIVIDE alternate result is empirically false in all three places it was written (DEC-014 'Coupled sub-decision', dax_measure_library.md § 2.2, and § 4's pattern bullet). Measured live with positive controls: DIVIDE(BLANK(),58,0)=BLANK, DIVIDE(BLANK(),BLANK(),0)=BLANK, while DIVIDE(1,BLANK(),0)=0 and DIVIDE(0,BLANK(),7)=7 -- the alternate result never fires on a BLANK numerator. TotalWeights can only go BLANK when EpiSubIndicators is empty or all weights are BLANK, and both force WeightedScores BLANK too, so the 0 was unreachable. Confirmed on the live OLD measure: CALCULATE([Weighted EPI Score], source_system="WGI") = BLANK, not 0. The removal is a defensively-correct no-op; the three passages must say so.
The false mechanism landed in dax_measure_library.md § 4 'DAX patterns in use', the canonical reference other measures are written against.
The confirmed [Latest Match Rate] / [Latest Coverage Rate] defect has no follow-up task; the diagnosis lives only in a docs blockquote and this task's notes.

Undisclosed consequence of the AVERAGEX wrapper: on any NON-country grouping the measure now returns a constant 44.141125003963616 (measured across 4 commodity_group rows, where the old measure returned a constant 7945.40) -- a self-evidently-broken number becomes a plausible-looking one. Needs a line in DEC-014 Consequences and in the measure docs.

DEC-014 is stamped decided_by: Erik on his verbatim 'wrap it', but the coupled DIVIDE removal was implementer-added and never put to him; the provenance of the two changes must be distinguished inside the record.

test_protocol.summary: Deploy the wrapped Weighted EPI Score and confirm in oem_report that it reads 0-100 uncontexted, is unchanged per country, and that no visual relies on a non-country grain.
test_protocol.automated_results: Verified offline against the live published model (dataset f57bdfa4) by running the literal TMDL text as DEFINE MEASURE: grand total 44.14112500396361 (old 7945.402500713453), Europe 58.59427624785278, 194 country keys with 180 non-blank, SUMX(VALUES(country_key), old) = 7945.40250071345 = the old grand total exactly. DIVIDE semantics re-measured with 6 positive controls; all 13 commodity_group rows return the constant. NOT verifiable offline: the deploy itself, the TMDL envelope parse at publish, and how the value renders in an actual report visual.

steps.instruction: Commit the working tree (fact_epi_score.tmdl, docs/dax_measure_library.md, docs/architecture/semantic_model.md) and push to main. This fires deploy-fabric.yml, which publishes the semantic model via fabric-cicd. Nothing has been committed or pushed by the agents.
steps.expected: deploy-fabric.yml green; the OEMInsightBI semantic model updates IN PLACE (fabric-cicd resolves by displayName, no duplicate item). A TMDL envelope parse error would surface here - it is the only check that cannot be run locally.

steps.instruction: Open oem_report and put [Weighted EPI Score] on a card with NO slicer or filter applied.
steps.expected: ~44.14, inside the 0-100 band. It must NOT read 7945.40 - that is the pre-change value and means the deploy did not land.

steps.instruction: Slice that same card to a single country (e.g. Sweden) and compare against the value you confirmed on 2026-08-04.
steps.expected: Identical to the pre-change single-country value - the wrapper is a no-op there (max delta 0.0 across all 194 country keys).

steps.instruction: Filter the card to region = Europe.
steps.expected: ~58.59 - the mean across the European countries in context, not a sum.

steps.instruction: Check whether any visual groups [Weighted EPI Score] by a NON-country axis (commodity_group, material, supplier). If one exists, look at the column.
steps.expected: Every row shows the same 44.14. Expected (fact_epi_score has no material grain) but it now reads as a plausible score rather than an obviously-broken 7945.40 - decide whether such a visual should exist at all.
